title: Moesha
description:
S5 E14 — Secrets and Lies
The arrival of Frank’s Aunt Hattie brings a shocking revelation about Frank that turns the rest of the family – especially Dorian and Moesha – against him.

S3 E6 — Men's Club
Mary is delighted to learn that Lester will be named 'Man of the Year' by the local Men's Club...and distraught upon discovering she's not allowed to attend the special ceremony.

S3 E7 — Low Noon
To protest the opening of a sleazy club in her neighborhood, Mary dreams of running the varmints out of town.

S3 E8 — Tangled Web
In an effort to help Lester build his business, Mary takes some questionable steps to land him a big construction contract.

S3 E9 — The Most Happy Marriage
Mary and Lester are shocked when his cousin Ed's enviable 'picture-perfect' marriage suddenly falls apart.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E16 — A Decent Proposal
Nicolette enlists Malcolm and Eddie to convince her boyfriend to propose.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E17 — Bachelor Daze
A friend's upcoming wedding cause Malcolm and Eddie to reexamine their feelings about the women in their own lives.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E18 — Mixed Nuts
A surprise birthday party for Malcolm's dad sets the Shermans and McGees to fighting.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E19 — The Slender Arm Of The Law
Eddie tries to help out the retired race car driver who helped get his first job.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E20 — A Few So-So Men
Malcolm unwittingly hires Eddie's longtime enemy to install a new bar at McGee's.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E18 — Watts Side Story
Fred is shocked when Lamont dates the sister of their Puerto Rican neighbor, Julio. The date becomes farcical when Fred's ploys to stop the date fail and he follows the couple -- in disguise.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E19 — Pops 'N Pals
Feeling jealous and neglected, Fred conjures up several ruses that will hopefully keep Lamont from spending so much time with Julio.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E20 — The Infernal Triangle
Lamont is upset when Fred announces that he plans to marry a young woman he has just met. When the young lady arrives at the house, Lamont is shocked to be face-to-face with one of his old girlfriends.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E21 — Home Sweet Home For The Aged
Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E22 — Pot Luck
Lamont outsmarts himself when he buys what he believes is a rare antique commode for only $20. Fred disapproves of the deal. Lamont insists that he can sell it for $400. Mr. Osborne, husband of the woman who sold the item, offers to buy it back for $200.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E23 — The Kid
Nine-year-old Jason (Lincoln Kilpatrick Jr.) worms his way into the Sanford yard and eventually into Fred's heart. Touched by the runaway's loneliness, Fred gets an idea to help others like Jason -- but he's not prepared for the results.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E14 — The Jefferson Curve
After watching George Jefferson in action, his young protege Marcus bends the truth to win the heart of a young lady and throws a curve that lands Lionel in foul territory.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.
